answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the violet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the echo until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ridge of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
